English labels/descriptions only when present in acquired same-edition material; other occupation labels remain Arabic. No European Commission endorsement.
metadata.reviewer_basis: Agent engineering source check of official CSV archive integrity, exact URI joins, complete English Turtle subject/literal blocks and Pydantic schema; not independent academic validation.
metadata.selection_basis: Up to four source-linked occupations per available English-described skill, preferring source English labels and professional groups; an accessibility-limited demonstration subset, not a representative taxonomy sample or programme mapping.
metadata.limitations: Version1.0.3 is old. Later ESCO releases changed labels/relations including transversal links. Currentness review is required before academic analysis.
